description: Brandriskvärden, analyserade is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Myndigheten för civilt försvar. In the decision support system Fire Risk Forest and Land, fire risk forecasts are calculated and meteorological data are reported to support decisions on issues of fire in vegetation. When the forecast has ended, the fire risk values are recalculated based on the latest available weather data. This "analysis data" is stored. Coverage: Myndigheten för civilt försvar. The portal shows the English title as "Fire risk values analysed" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Myndigheten för civilt försvar. Its keywords include Myndigheten för civilt försvar, Geodatasamverkan, Inspire, HVD. The listing shows 4 download or service links in HTML, 19139+XML, XML. The listing shows 1999-03-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
